end.summary:
Practised making one mark for each object to keep track without numbers.
Matched marks to objects to identify missing or extra items.
Used marks, crossed marks, and finger counts in examples.
Completed two marking tasks and three matching tasks without help.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Parth practised making one mark for each ball or object, then matching the marks back to check what was missing or extra. They used one-to-one matching correctly in the recorded tasks, including matching four fingers to four marks and finding one mark left after five were crossed from six. Asha can practise this at home by placing small objects in a row and having Parth make one mark for each, then check the marks again.
